title: Coherence of a module is local on an open covering
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $\mathcal F$ an $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and $X=\bigcup_{i\in I}U_i$ a covering by open subschemes; for an open $W\subseteq X$ write $\mathcal F|_W$ for the restriction of $\mathcal F$ to the open subscheme $W$ ($(\mathcal F|_W)(V)=\mathcal F(V)$ for $V\subseteq W$ open, as in [lem-weil-pbc-module-restriction-open-immersion-colimits]). (1) If $\mathcal F$ is coherent [pqf-def-coherent], then $\mathcal F|_W$ is a coherent $\mathcal O_W$-module for every open $W\subseteq X$. (2) If $\mathcal F|_{U_i}$ is a coherent $\mathcal O_{U_i}$-module for every $i\in I$, then $\mathcal F$ is a coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module. (Both conditions of [pqf-def-coherent] are local: being of finite type is a condition on neighbourhoods of points, and for the kernel condition over an open $W$ one restricts to the $W\cap U_i$, kernels of $\mathcal O_X$-modules being computed sectionwise.)

source.place: Stacks, Sheaves of Modules, Definition 01BV (definition-coherent) and Definition 01B5 (definition-finite-type); the locality is used without statement in the proof of Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 0CYJ (coherent-lemma-pushforward-coherent-on-open, literature/stacks-project/coherent.tex)

proof.text: *Step 1 (restriction to opens).* Throughout, a surjection of $\mathcal O_W$-modules means an epimorphism of the abelian category $\Mod(\mathcal O_W)$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and "of finite type" and "coherent" are as in [pqf-def-coherent]. For opens $V\subseteq W\subseteq X$ of the scheme $X$ [def-pc-scheme]: (a) $\mathcal O_X|_W=\mathcal O_W$ and $(\mathcal G|_W)|_V=\mathcal G|_V$ for every $\mathcal O_X$-module $\mathcal G$, with $(\alpha|_W)|_V=\alpha|_V$ for morphisms: by the formula of [lem-weil-pbc-module-restriction-open-immersion-colimits] (for inclusions of open subschemes $f(U)=U$ and $f^\sharp$ is the identity), both sides have sections $\mathcal G(V')$ over $V'\subseteq V$ open, the same restriction maps and the same $\mathcal O_X(V')$-action. (b) Restriction $\mathcal G\mapsto\mathcal G|_V$, $\Mod(\mathcal O_W)\to\Mod(\mathcal O_V)$, is a left adjoint [lem-weil-pbc-module-restriction-open-immersion-colimits](1), so it preserves coproducts, whence $(\mathcal O_W^{\oplus n})|_V\cong\mathcal O_V^{\oplus n}$ by (a); and it preserves epimorphisms: if $e$ is an epimorphism and $g\circ e|_V=h\circ e|_V$, the adjoint transposes satisfy $g^\flat\circ e=h^\flat\circ e$, so $g^\flat=h^\flat$ and $g=h$. (c) For a morphism $\varphi:\mathcal G\to\mathcal H$ of $\mathcal O_W$-modules, $\Ker(\varphi)|_V=\Ker(\varphi|_V)$: kernels in $\Mod(\mathcal O_W)$ and $\Mod(\mathcal O_V)$ are computed sectionwise [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], so both have sections $\ker(\varphi_{V'}:\mathcal G(V')\to\mathcal H(V'))$ over $V'\subseteq V$, with the same restriction maps and module structures. (d) Being of finite type is invariant under isomorphism (compose the surjection $\mathcal O_U^{\oplus n}\to\mathcal G|_U$ with the restricted isomorphism).

source.place: Stacks, Sheaves of Modules, Definitions 01B5 and 01BV; restriction to an open as the pullback $j^*$ in the proof of Lemma 01B6 (lemma-pullback-finite-type)

proof.text: *Step 2 (finite type restricts).* Let $\mathcal G$ be an $\mathcal O_X$-module of finite type and $W\subseteq X$ open. For $x\in W$ choose by [pqf-def-coherent] an open $U\ni x$ of $X$ and a surjection $\mathcal O_U^{\oplus n}\to\mathcal G|_U$. Restricting it to the open $U\cap W$ gives by Step 1(a),(b) a surjection $\mathcal O_{U\cap W}^{\oplus n}\cong(\mathcal O_U^{\oplus n})|_{U\cap W}\to\mathcal G|_{U\cap W}=(\mathcal G|_W)|_{U\cap W}$, and $U\cap W$ is an open neighbourhood of $x$ in $W$. Hence $\mathcal G|_W$ is of finite type.

source.place: Stacks, Sheaves of Modules, Definition 01B5 and Lemma 01B6 (lemma-pullback-finite-type) for the open immersion $W\to X$

proof.text: *Step 3 (part (1)).* Let $\mathcal F$ be coherent and $W\subseteq X$ open. $\mathcal F|_W$ is of finite type by Step 2. Let $W'\subseteq W$ be open and $\varphi:\mathcal O_{W'}^{\oplus n}\to(\mathcal F|_W)|_{W'}$ a morphism. By Step 1(a) $(\mathcal F|_W)|_{W'}=\mathcal F|_{W'}$, and $W'$ is open in $X$, so the kernel of $\varphi$ is of finite type by the kernel condition of [pqf-def-coherent] for $\mathcal F$. Hence $\mathcal F|_W$ is a coherent $\mathcal O_W$-module.

*Step 4 (finite type is local).* Let $W\subseteq X$ be open, $W=\bigcup_iW_i$ an open covering and $\mathcal G$ an $\mathcal O_W$-module with $\mathcal G|_{W_i}$ of finite type for every $i$. For $x\in W$ pick $i$ with $x\in W_i$; by [pqf-def-coherent] for $\mathcal G|_{W_i}$ there are an open $V\ni x$ of $W_i$ and a surjection $\mathcal O_V^{\oplus n}\to(\mathcal G|_{W_i})|_V=\mathcal G|_V$ (Step 1(a)). $V$ is open in $W$, so $\mathcal G$ is of finite type.

source.place: Stacks, Sheaves of Modules, Definition 01B5 (definition-finite-type): the condition is on a neighbourhood of each point

proof.text: *Step 5 (part (2)).* Let $\mathcal F|_{U_i}$ be coherent for all $i$. $\mathcal F$ is of finite type by Step 4 (with $W=X$, $W_i=U_i$). Let $W\subseteq X$ be open and $\varphi:\mathcal O_W^{\oplus n}\to\mathcal F|_W$ a morphism with kernel $\mathcal K$. Put $W_i=W\cap U_i$, an open of $U_i$; these cover $W$. By Step 1, $\mathcal K|_{W_i}=\Ker(\varphi|_{W_i})$ and $\varphi|_{W_i}$ is, up to the isomorphism $\mathcal O_{W_i}^{\oplus n}\cong(\mathcal O_W^{\oplus n})|_{W_i}$, a morphism $\mathcal O_{W_i}^{\oplus n}\to\mathcal F|_{W_i}=(\mathcal F|_{U_i})|_{W_i}$; composing with an isomorphism of the source replaces the kernel by an isomorphic one. By the kernel condition of [pqf-def-coherent] for the coherent $\mathcal O_{U_i}$-module $\mathcal F|_{U_i}$ and its open $W_i$, this kernel is of finite type, hence so is $\mathcal K|_{W_i}$ (Step 1(d)). By Step 4, $\mathcal K$ is of finite type. So $\mathcal F$ satisfies both conditions of [pqf-def-coherent] and is coherent.

split_report.summary: Wrote the proof in five elementary steps unwinding pqf-def-coherent (Stacks 01B5, 01BV): Step 1 collects the restriction facts (transitivity of restriction and O_X|_W=O_W from the explicit formula of the restriction node; restriction is a left adjoint, so it preserves the finite direct sums O^n and epimorphisms; kernels are sectionwise by def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, so restriction commutes with kernels); Step 2 finite type restricts to opens (as Stacks 01B6 for j^*); Step 3 part (1); Step 4 finite type is local on an open cover; Step 5 part (2) by restricting the kernel of O_W^n -> F|_W to the W cap U_i. No new node: every argument is an instance of the definitions or of the restriction node (1). Statement and stmt_deps kept. lean.statement: theorem coherent_module_local_on_open_cover (X : Scheme.{u}) (F : X.Modules) (I : Type u) (U : I → X.Opens) (hU : ⨆ i, U i = ⊤) : (RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace F → ∀ (W : X.Opens), RingedSpace.IsCoherent W.toScheme.toRingedSpace ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor W.ι).obj F)) ∧ ((∀ (i : I), RingedSpace.IsCoherent (U i).toScheme.toRingedSpace ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (U i).ι).obj F)) → RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace F)
